zh: 宇宙学的全部"创世参数"其实没几个。这个实验室不讲课：每个展区先把现象、数据或当年真实的困难摆在你面前，让你自己拨参数、做实验，把结论重新发现出来。
en: Cosmology has surprisingly few "parameters of creation". This lab does not lecture: each hall first puts the phenomena, the data or the real difficulty of the time in front of you, and lets you turn the knobs, run the experiments and rediscover the conclusions yourself.

zh: 研究这个问题需要什么
en: What it takes to study this question

zh: 广义相对论：爱因斯坦方程把时空几何和物质能量绑在一起。
en: General relativity: Einstein's equations tie the geometry of spacetime to matter and energy.

zh: 对称性假设：假设宇宙处处一样、各向一样（FLRW），十个方程就缩成一个——弗里德曼方程。放弃各向同性（哥德尔、Kasner），就会出现旋转、各向异性膨胀这些怪物。
en: Symmetry assumptions: assume the universe is the same everywhere and in every direction (FLRW) and ten equations collapse into one — the Friedmann equation. Give up isotropy (Gödel, Kasner) and monsters appear: rotation, anisotropic expansion.

zh: 物质清单：辐射、物质、宇宙学常数 Λ（或更一般的暗能量 w）、曲率。它们就是创世参数。
en: The inventory of matter: radiation, matter, the cosmological constant Λ (or a more general dark energy w), curvature. These are the parameters of creation.

zh: 观测：标准烛光（超新星）、标准尺（声学视界）、最老恒星、CMB。只能从这些反推。
en: Observations: standard candles (supernovae), a standard ruler (the sound horizon), the oldest stars, the CMB. Everything must be inferred from these.

zh: 各理论为什么冲突
en: Why the theories clashed

zh: 1917 爱因斯坦：宇宙该是静止的，于是加了 Λ；弗里德曼（1922）和勒梅特（1927）算出它必然膨胀或收缩，哈勃 1929 证实膨胀。
en: 1917, Einstein: the universe ought to be static, so he added Λ; Friedmann (1922) and Lemaître (1927) showed it must expand or contract, and Hubble confirmed the expansion in 1929.

zh: 1949 哥德尔：同一套方程允许一个旋转的宇宙，里面可以回到自己的过去——那"时间"还算数吗？
en: 1949, Gödel: the same equations allow a rotating universe in which you can travel back into your own past — does "time" still mean anything there?

zh: 1998：超新星偏暗，宇宙在加速；被爱因斯坦抛弃的 Λ 回来了，但它为什么这么小？温伯格的回答：太大的 Λ 根本长不出星系，也就没人能问这个问题。
en: 1998: supernovae are too faint, the universe is accelerating; the Λ Einstein had discarded is back, but why is it so small? Weinberg's answer: a Λ much larger would never let galaxies grow, and there would be nobody to ask the question.

zh: 这个实验室打算让你看到什么
en: What this lab wants you to see

zh: 创世台：随手拨出来的宇宙大多死寂；诊断会告诉你死在哪一步，并给你十一组方程允许、各有性格的宇宙。
en: Forge: most universes you dial up at random are dead; the diagnosis tells you at which step they died, and gives you eleven universes the equations allow, each with a character of its own.

zh: 哥德尔旋转宇宙：精确解里亲手发一束光，看它绕回来；看光锥一点点倾倒，直到可以沿一个圈走回过去。
en: Gödel's rotating universe: fire a beam of light inside an exact solution and watch it come back around; watch the light cones tip over, little by little, until a loop leads back into the past.

zh: Mixmaster：放弃各向同性，看三根轴在奇点附近混沌地跳无穷多次，并亲手核对 BKL 的跳法规则。
en: Mixmaster: give up isotropy and watch three axes bounce chaotically, infinitely many times, near the singularity — and check the BKL bouncing rule with your own hands.

zh: 空洞宇宙：放弃均匀性，住进一个几十亿光年的空洞中心——没有暗能量也能骗过超新星，再看它怎么被戳穿。
en: Void universe: give up homogeneity and live at the center of a void billions of light-years across — it fools the supernovae without any dark energy; then watch how it gets caught.

zh: 泡泡宇宙：放弃"只有一个宇宙"，看永恒暴胀的泡沫怎么按成核率长出来、你被哪个泡吞没、抽到的 Λ 能不能长出星系。
en: Bubble universe: give up "there is only one universe" and watch the foam of eternal inflation grow at its nucleation rate, see which bubble swallows you, and whether the Λ you drew can grow galaxies.

zh: 多连通宇宙：放弃"空间无限"，住进一个有限无边的三维环面——鬼像、天上的匹配圆、被截断的大角度功率，全从一个周期随机场里采出来。
en: Multiply connected universe: give up "space is infinite" and live in a finite three-torus with no boundary — ghost images, matched circles in the sky, truncated large-angle power, all sampled from one periodic random field.

zh: 2+1 维引力：少一个空间维度，引力消失了，却还有锥形的双像、BTZ 黑洞的温度和熵、不减速的尘埃宇宙。
en: 2+1 gravity: drop one spatial dimension and gravity disappears — yet there are still conical double images, the temperature and entropy of the BTZ black hole, and a dust universe that never decelerates.

zh: 反推台：只给你一个隐藏宇宙的观测数据，你来判断它的形状和命运。
en: Inference bench: you get only the observational data of a hidden universe, and you work out its shape and its fate.

zh: ④ 这个宇宙的创世参数

zh: 哥德尔宇宙只有一个旋钮：物质密度 $\rho$（或等价的转动角速度 $\omega = \sqrt{4\pi G\rho}$）。宇宙学常数被方程锁死为 $\Lambda = -\omega^2$，你调不了它。这个旋钮是换算器：①里的星空是另一个密度未知的宇宙，②③用坐标单位画，形状和 $\omega$ 无关——变的只是它们对应多少光年、多少年。
en: Gödel's universe has a single knob: the matter density $\rho$ (or, equivalently, the angular velocity of rotation $\omega = \sqrt{4\pi G\rho}$). The equations lock the cosmological constant to $\Lambda = -\omega^2$; you cannot change it. This knob is a converter: the sky in ① belongs to another universe whose density is unknown, and ② and ③ are drawn in coordinate units whose shape does not depend on $\omega$ — all that changes is how many light-years and how many years they correspond to.

zh: 物质密度 ρ / ρm,我们
en: Matter density ρ / ρm,ours

zh: 相对我们宇宙今天的物质密度（对数刻度）
en: relative to the matter density of our universe today (log scale)

zh: 读完你自己的发现之后再看：这个宇宙在说什么
en: Read after you have made your own discoveries: what this universe is saying

zh: 为什么转动会制造时间机器？在旋转的宇宙里，远处的物质相对你的陀螺仪在动，光锥（"未来"允许的方向）被拖着一起倾倒。倾倒的角度随半径增大，到 sinh r = 1 时，"原地绕轴转一圈"这条闭合曲线恰好变成光速可走；再往外，它就落进光锥内部，成为一条闭合类时曲线——一艘火箭沿它飞，手表一直在走，却回到了出发的那个事件。哥德尔由此论证：既然相对论允许这样的宇宙，"客观流逝的时间"就不是物理定律必然给出的东西。
en: Why does rotation build a time machine? In a rotating universe the distant matter moves relative to your gyroscope, and the light cones (the directions "the future" allows) are dragged over with it. The tilt grows with the radius; at sinh r = 1 the closed curve "go once around the axis staying where you are" becomes exactly traversable at the speed of light; farther out it falls inside the light cone and becomes a closed timelike curve — a rocket flying along it keeps its watch running, yet returns to the very event it left from. Gödel's argument: if relativity allows such a universe, "objectively flowing time" is not something the laws of physics necessarily provide.

zh: 为什么光回来了？从轴发出的光，角动量为零，径向速度在 sinh r = 1 处被拖到零，然后折回，在坐标时 t ≈ 1.29（哥德尔单位）全部重新聚焦到轴上。轴上的观察者永远看不到 r_c 之外——这是哥德尔宇宙的"视界"。
en: Why did the light come back? Light leaving the axis has zero angular momentum; its radial velocity is dragged to zero at sinh r = 1, then it turns back, and at coordinate time t ≈ 1.29 (Gödel units) all of it refocuses onto the axis. An observer on the axis never sees beyond r_c — that is the "horizon" of Gödel's universe.

zh: 它是我们的宇宙吗？不是：它不膨胀，Λ 还是负的。但它是合法的解。观测上，CMB 的各向同性把今天宇宙的整体转动压到极小：Planck 数据给出与涡度相关的各向异性 (σV/H)0 < 4.7×10⁻¹¹（95%，Saadeh 等 2016）。如果我们的宇宙是哥德尔式的、物质密度就是今天的 ρm，星空每 … 转一圈，而时间机器的圈在 … 之外。
en: Is it our universe? No: it does not expand, and Λ is negative. But it is a legitimate solution. Observationally, the isotropy of the CMB pins any overall rotation of today's universe to a tiny value: the Planck data give a vorticity-related anisotropy (σV/H)0 < 4.7×10⁻¹¹ (95%, Saadeh et al. 2016). If our universe were Gödel-like, with matter density equal to today's ρm, the sky would make one turn every …, and the time-machine loops would lie beyond ….

zh: ⑤ 站在轴上看整个天空 模拟 每个像素一条零测地线，从你眼睛倒着追到星系；没有红移，面亮度守恒
en: ⑤ Standing on the axis, looking at the whole sky simulated one null geodesic per pixel, traced backwards from your eye to the galaxies; no redshift, surface brightness conserved

zh: 全天图（横轴方位角 ψ，纵轴和转轴的夹角 θ，像地图一样摊开）。星系按坐标固定在旋转的尘埃上；每一束光都按②里的方程往回追，光绕回轴几次都算上。指到（或点一下）天上的任何一点，右边会画出那束光走过的路。"来回数"只决定追多远：大多数像在第一个来回里就出现了，所以 2 和 3 个来回看到的星系数常常一样。
en: An all-sky map (azimuth ψ along the horizontal axis, angle θ from the rotation axis along the vertical, spread flat like a map). The galaxies are fixed in coordinates on the rotating dust; every ray is traced backwards with the equations of ②, counting however many times the light winds back to the axis. Point at (or tap) any spot in the sky and the panel on the right draws the path that ray took. The "round trips" setting only decides how far to trace: most images appear within the first round trip, so 2 and 3 round trips often show the same number of galaxies.

en: How to play

zh: 先看低红移：z ≲ 0.1 的超新星只认 H₀——斜率定了它。
en: Start at low redshift: supernovae at z ≲ 0.1 only know about H₀ — the slope fixes it.

zh: 再看高红移弯不弯：高 z 的烛光比空宇宙的参照线更暗还是更亮？暗 = 走得更远 = 加速过。
en: Then see whether the high-redshift end bends: are the high-z candles fainter or brighter than the empty-universe reference line? Fainter = farther away = there was acceleration.

zh: 标准尺定曲率：同一把尺在封闭宇宙里显得大、开放宇宙里显得小。
en: The standard ruler fixes the curvature: the same ruler looks larger in a closed universe and smaller in an open one.

zh: 年龄做底线：模型给的年龄不能比最老的恒星还小。
en: The age is the floor: the model's age cannot be smaller than the oldest stars.

zh: 拟合质量 χ²/N 接近 1 就锁定答案，看看你猜中了形状和命运没有。
en: Lock in your answer once the goodness of fit χ²/N is close to 1, and see whether you guessed the shape and the fate.
